{
  "subject_template": "Early Payment Offer for {INVOICE_NO} with {VENDOR}",
  "body_template": "Dear {VENDOR},

We hope this message finds you well. As a valued partner, we're pleased to offer you a {DISC_PCT} discount on your invoice {INVOICE_NO} for early payment. By paying the amount of {AMOUNT} by {PAY_BY}, you'll save {SAVINGS}. This payment will be processed instantly via RTP to your bank account. Please let us know if you'd like to proceed.

Thank you for your continued partnership.

Sincerely,
Accounts Payable"
}
